notes: ‘The Big 12 Conference has announced a new multi-year partnership with Monster Energy that will make the global beverage company the entitlement partner for the conference’s football and men’s and women’s basketball regular seasons.’
Monster Energy is an energy drink company; industry classified by researcher.
‘Beginning this season, all conference-controlled football and basketball assets’ carry the partnership (announced 7 July 2026).
The agreement is described only as ‘multi-year’; no report read gives the number of years.

source_name: Front Office Sports, college jersey patch tracker (published 28 Jul 2026, updated 27 Oct 2026)
notes: ‘Monster Energy is paying the Big 12 $20 million per year in exchange for its logo to appear on the football and men’s and women’s basketball jerseys of all competing schools.’ News 9 (7 Jul 2026), citing Sports Business Journal, gives ‘approximately $20 million annually’. Paid to the conference, not to a school.

‘would rake in $20 million per year for schools, offering around $1 million per school, Front Office Sports confirmed.’ Reported as an approximate figure; one columnist (John Canzano, 8 Jul 2026) reports $1.25 million a school.

value: Co-branded patch on football and men's and women's basketball jerseys of all members, field and court logos, and naming of the regular seasons
notes: ‘First, all Big 12 football and men’s and women’s basketball teams and fields/courts will include the co-branded patches.’ The agreement does not stop members from selling their own jersey patches.
